description_en: Queries the details of an agent version
kebab_example: aliyun agentcore get-agent-version --workspace-id ws-0123456789abcdef01234 --agent-id agent-0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef --agent-version v1 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetAgentVersion

parameters.help_en: The ID of the AgentCore workspace where the agent resides
parameters.help_zh: 智能体所在的 AgentCore 工作空间 ID
parameters.name: workspace_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the managed or custom agent
parameters.help_zh: 托管智能体或自定义智能体 ID
parameters.name: agent_id

parameters.help_en: The system-generated version number, such as v1. This is the agentVersion returned by CreateAgentVersion or ListAgentVersions, not the versionName
parameters.help_zh: 系统生成的版本号，例如 v1，即 CreateAgentVersion 或 ListAgentVersions 返回的 agentVersion，不是 versionName
parameters.name: agent_version

code.description_en: The business status code. The value is SUCCESS if the request is successful, or an error code if the request fails
code.description_zh: 业务状态码，请求成功时为 SUCCESS，失败时为错误码

data.description_en: The details of the fixed agent version. The configuration field contains the agent configuration at the time the version was saved
data.description_zh: 智能体固定版本详情，configuration 为版本保存时的 Agent 配置

agentId.description_en: The ID of the managed or custom agent that owns the version
agentId.description_zh: 版本所属的托管智能体或自定义智能体 ID

agentVersion.description_en: The system-generated version number that increments for each agent, such as v1 and v2. This is used when querying or deleting versions, and when referencing versions in service endpoints
agentVersion.description_zh: 系统按 Agent 递增生成的版本号，例如 v1、v2。查询、删除版本及服务端点引用版本时使用

artifactStatus.description_en: Indicates only whether the version template and artifact archiving are complete, and does not represent the deployment or running status. A value of READY indicates that the archiving is complete. A value of INVALID indicates that the archiving is missing or inconsistent
artifactStatus.description_zh: 仅表示版本模板与制品归档是否完整，不代表部署或运行状态。READY 为完整，INVALID 为归档缺失或不一致

additionalProperties.description_en: The values of the agent configuration items when the version was saved. The keys are the data field names returned by GetManagedAgent or GetCustomAgent, such as name, instruction, and model. The value types depend on the fields and can be strings, numbers, Boolean values, objects, or arrays
additionalProperties.description_zh: 版本保存时的 Agent 配置项的值。键为 GetManagedAgent 或 GetCustomAgent 返回的 data 字段名，如 name、instruction、model；值类型随字段而定，可能为字符串、数值、布尔值、对象或数组

configuration.description_en: For managed agents, the structure is consistent with the data structure of GetManagedAgent. For custom agents, the structure is consistent with the data structure of GetCustomAgent. The desensitization rules are the same
configuration.description_zh: 托管智能体与 GetManagedAgent 的 data 结构一致，自定义智能体与 GetCustomAgent 的 data 结构一致，脱敏规则相同
configuration.example: {"agentId":"agent-0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef","workspaceId":"ws-0123456789abcdef01234","name":"customer-service","description":"客服智能体","status":"Running","latestSpecVersion":2,"instruction":"你是一名客服助手。"}
configuration.title_en: 版本保存时的 Agent 配置
configuration.title_zh: 版本保存时的 Agent 配置

createdAt.description_en: The time when the version was saved, in ISO 8601 UTC format
createdAt.description_zh: 版本保存的时间，采用 ISO 8601 UTC 格式
createdAt.title_en: 版本创建时间，采用 ISO 8601 UTC 格式
createdAt.title_zh: 版本创建时间，采用 ISO 8601 UTC 格式

createdBy.description_en: The UID of the Alibaba Cloud account of the caller who saved the version. If the API is called by a RAM user, this value is the UID of the Alibaba Cloud account to which the RAM user belongs
createdBy.description_zh: 保存该版本的调用者阿里云账号 UID；RAM 用户调用时为其所属阿里云主账号 UID

description.description_en: The version description provided when the version was saved. It can contain up to 1,024 characters. If no description was provided when the version was saved, this field is empty
description.description_zh: 保存版本时填写的版本描述，最多 1024 个字符；保存时未填写则为空

targetSpecVersion.description_en: The effective release serial number of the agent when the version was saved, which is the effectiveSpecVersion at that time. This value does not change after the version is saved
targetSpecVersion.description_zh: 保存版本时 Agent 已生效的发布流水号，即当时的 effectiveSpecVersion。版本保存后该值不再变化
targetSpecVersion.title_en: 保存时固化的 Agent 发布流水号，即保存时的 effectiveSpecVersion
targetSpecVersion.title_zh: 保存时固化的 Agent 发布流水号，即保存时的 effectiveSpecVersion

versionName.description_en: The display name specified by the user when the version was saved. For earlier saved versions that did not record a name, the agentVersion is returned
versionName.description_zh: 保存版本时用户指定的展示名称。早期保存且未记录名称的版本返回 agentVersion

workspaceId.description_en: The ID of the AgentCore workspace where the agent that owns the version resides
workspaceId.description_zh: 版本所属智能体所在的 AgentCore 工作空间 ID

message.description_en: The response message. The value is success if the request is successful, or an error message if the request fails
message.description_zh: 响应消息，请求成功时为 success，失败时为错误信息

requestId.description_en: The request ID, which is used to locate and troubleshoot the request
requestId.description_zh: 请求 ID，用于定位和排查请求
requestId.title_en: 请求 ID，用于定位和排查请求
requestId.title_zh: 请求 ID，用于定位和排查请求

success.description_en: Indicates whether the request is successful
